label: Cooldown bands
description: How often an ability can be used.

terms.label: Spammable
terms.description: About 1-3 seconds; several uses in every fight.

terms.label: Short
terms.description: About 5-10 seconds; a couple of uses per fight.

terms.label: Medium
terms.description: About 15-30 seconds; roughly once per fight.

terms.label: Long
terms.description: About 45-90 seconds; a few uses per life.

terms.label: Once per life
terms.description: One use per life or purchase, restocked only at a resupply point or on respawn.
